nodes.title: SG-1.1 Define fantasy colour, type and spacing tokens
nodes.body:
Context: src/lib/palette.ts holds the old retro ramps (indigo, plum, moon, hoodie, wood, brass, parchment, lamp) and src/lib/tokens.ts exposes pixel fonts and a three-step type scale. Desired behaviour: tokens.ts and palette.ts expose bronze, antique gold, dark brown, muted crimson, iron, stone and parchment ramps (plus a muted moss ramp), a title/heading/body/caption type scale and spacing/size/breakpoint tokens, consumed by tokensToCssVars() and tailwind.config.ts, with a unit test that body text on panel backgrounds meets 4.5:1. Why: this is the base every later redesign step builds on.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given palette.ts, when PALETTE_RAMPS is read, then it holds dark fantasy ramps with at most 48 unique hex colours
- Given tokens.ts, when tokensToCssVars() is called, then colour, type, spacing, size and breakpoint variables exist
- Given tailwind.config.ts, when theme.extend is read, then colours, spacing, fontSize, fontFamily and screens reference the tokens
- Given every body-text/panel-background pair, when contrastRatio is computed, then it is at least 4.5


## Scope
- In scope: src/lib/palette.ts
- In scope: src/lib/tokens.ts
- In scope: tailwind.config.ts
- In scope: src/lib/contrast.ts
- In scope: ramp name references in src/art
- In scope: token consumers in styles.css and components
- Out of scope: new frame/texture assets (SG-1.2)
- Out of scope: loading fonts and rewriting base styles (SG-1.3)
- Out of scope: gameplay logic
- Preserve: Phaser ~3.90.0, React 18, Tailwind 3, zustand, vitest
- Preserve: store and API contracts
- Preserve: data-testid and aria-label hooks


## Technical constraints
- Keep Phaser pinned at ~3.90.0 with the existing stack; no new rendering framework
- Do not change gameplay logic
- Dark medieval palette with no bright colours
- Keep the existing HTML-overlay versus Phaser-canvas split
- Text must keep readable contrast and a defined typography hierarchy
- Unit tests mock every dependency; update existing tests that assert old names


## Definition of done
- All acceptance criteria covered by passing unit tests


## Non-functional requirements
- AA contrast for body text


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: Type scale, spacing, size and breakpoint tokens feed CSS vars and Tailwind
nodes.body:
COLOR_TOKENS follow the new ramps; TYPE_TOKENS define a fantasy display font, a readable body font and a title/heading/body/caption scale; SPACING_TOKENS gain steps; SIZE_TOKENS and BREAKPOINT_TOKENS are added; old pixel-font and sm/md/lg names are removed with their consumers.

## Acceptance criteria
- tokensToCssVars() returns --sf-size-title/heading/body/caption, --sf-font-display, --sf-font-body, --sf-space-*, --sf-icon-* and --sf-bp-* variables
- tailwind.config.ts maps fontSize sf-title/sf-heading/sf-body/sf-caption, fontFamily display/body and screens to the variables
- No source references --sf-font-pixel, text-sf-sm, text-sf-md or old colour token names


## Scope
- In scope: src/lib/tokens.ts
- In scope: tailwind.config.ts
- In scope: src/styles.css
- In scope: GameLayout, ObjectOverlay, ContributionSheet, StoryPanel, HeaderOverlay, ui/button
- Out of scope: loading the font files
- Preserve: existing data-testid and aria-label hooks


## Technical constraints
- Replace old classes; do not keep two parallel token sets
- Text must keep a defined typography hierarchy


## Dependencies
- R1


## Definition of done
- Token and tailwind tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None
